moderate: Scene 3 'A thought you finish', sentences 1 and 3 (explain/reflect gestures): the standing reader's extended arm points to the right edge of the stage, away from the 'One small change' card, the thread and the '“I understood.”' bubble, which are all to her left; the gesture addresses empty space instead of the referent (visible at scene start, 20% of s1, and 20%/50% of s3, all themes).

Scene 3 sentence 1 ('practical encouragement'): the 'determined' expression renders as a stern scowl (V-shaped brows, flat tight mouth) that reads as anger or disapproval while the narration encourages one small, verifiable change.

Curiosity cues render as sadness: scene 1 sentence 2 ('curiosity', asks why abundance leaves an idea unfinished) and scene 3 sentence 2 ('generous openness', formats cooperate) both show raised inner brows and a downturned mouth at 20% and 50%; in scene 1 the open-arm 'question' gesture is visible at 20% but has ended by the sentence midpoint, so the curious/open beat reads as worried/sad.
minor: Reader asset: a white '$page' detail bar (detail.n3) sits across the scarf and collar in every frame and theme; at 1200 px it reads as a stray stripe or badge rather than clothing (shared person-21 asset detail).
Scene 1 sentence 1 ('quiet recognition', tired): the reader shows a content half-smile, so the end-of-day fatigue is not legible.

Scene 1 sentence 3: the visual adds a dashed 'Impression' check but does not contrast it with the short form; the feed column and fragments remain the dominant element, so the 'not the short form' half of the distinction is carried by narration alone.

Scene 1 sentence 4 / end: where thread-1 enters the feed column it overlaps the orange bar and the stitch path, forming a small knot over the column face; at 50% the next segment's stub floats right of fragment 4 while drawing.
Scene 2 sentence 2 at ~20%: a moving finding token passes over the 'Recommendations' tray label before settling; transient overlap.
Dark theme: the seated reader's trousers and the chair frame both turn pale blue-grey, so legs and chair merge slightly in scene 1.
Phone widths (393/320 px): scene 2 labels (Premises/Conditions/Alternatives, tray names, Padding/False coherence) and the scene 1 'Impression' label render at roughly 7-9 px and are barely legible.
